generated_by.what: Expected values for tests/liljegren.test.ts and tests/wbgt-audit.test.ts, produced by the validated Python model the TypeScript is a port of.
generated_by.code: conduit-app src/joto_guard/{wbgt,solar,solar_calibration}.py at the revision carrying WBGT v1.1 and the NOAA solar equations
generated_by.inputs: data/conduit_master_2025_2026.csv (this repo), hourly means per UTC hour of temp_sht, humidity_sht, press_bmx, wind_spd, si1145_ir and wet_bulb_globe_temp; irradiance from conduit-app/config/solar_calibration.json
generated_by.station_hours: every 46th audited hour, so the sample spans the whole archive
generated_by.regenerate: run the generator against the conduit-app checkout: ./.venv/bin/python make_fixture.py <this repo>/data/conduit_master_2025_2026.csv <this repo>/tests/fixtures/liljegren-reference.json
generated_by.note: Data, not a target to tune to: the TypeScript reproduces these numbers because it runs the same equations, not because they were fitted.

calibration.formula: GHI = (IR counts - dark floor) * (a + b * (1 - mu)), mu = hourly mean cos(solar zenith)
calibration.reference: ERA5 hourly shortwave radiation, Open-Meteo archive API (models=era5), grid -1.0, 37.0
